semanticStates.name: Waiting to start
semanticStates.description: The request is recorded; processing has not started.

semanticStates.name: Transcribing
semanticStates.description: A current attempt is processing the authorized request.

semanticStates.name: Transcript ready to review
semanticStates.description: The result is recorded; review is still required where applicable.

semanticStates.name: Outcome not confirmed
semanticStates.description: The request may have started; check its status before taking another action.

semanticStates.name: Checking source file
semanticStates.description: Integrity, format, and policy checks are still in progress.

semanticStates.name: Source ready
semanticStates.description: Source integrity was verified for this fixture; runtime availability is not implied.

semanticStates.name: Source needs review
semanticStates.description: The source is isolated and cannot be used until its disposition is recorded.

semanticStates.name: Processing stopped by consent change
semanticStates.description: New processing is blocked; existing output and deletion scope follow the owning lifecycle policy.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 1
navigationPrinciples.description: Preserve project, exact source version, selected language intent, source time, job identity, and draft edits across navigation.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 2
navigationPrinciples.description: Keep recovery available from every job state; never route OUTCOME_UNKNOWN to a new submission.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 3
navigationPrinciples.description: Back navigation returns to the prior view and position without committing a draft or changing source media.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 4
navigationPrinciples.description: Keep upload identity, selected project target, acknowledged transfer state, and source identity through navigation.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 5
navigationPrinciples.description: An unknown upload result returns to inspection of the same upload identity; it never enables duplicate transfer.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 6
navigationPrinciples.description: Enter the job view only with an owner-issued stable job identity; an upload identity alone is not a job.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 7
navigationPrinciples.description: Integrity, format, rights, retention, and project-attachment dispositions remain separately visible.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 8
navigationPrinciples.description: Preserve the requested destination and non-sensitive intent draft across the identity handoff.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 9
navigationPrinciples.description: Do not show protected project data before the current workspace decision is confirmed.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 10
navigationPrinciples.description: An uncertain project-create result returns to the same request for reconciliation; it does not enable blind duplicate creation.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 11
navigationPrinciples.description: Preserve the same job identity when leaving and re-entering the status view.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 12
navigationPrinciples.description: Stop watching is view navigation only; it does not cancel work or change job state.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 13
navigationPrinciples.description: Keep cancellation pending until owner evidence confirms a stop or a racing result.

navigationPrinciples.name: Navigation rule 14
navigationPrinciples.description: For unknown outcomes, check the existing job before any new submission.

decisionPatterns.description: Confirm only consequential effects that cannot be safely undone; explain scope and affected version.

localizationRules.strategy: A locale present in a fixture is not an admitted runtime language.
Keep user-facing translations separate from stable action IDs, field names, and reason codes.
Preserve original recognized text and record translation as a derived version with provenance.
Never silently convert transcript language or measurement units.
Dates, numbers, decimal marks, and time display follow the selected presentation locale while stored rational media time remains unchanged.
Unsupported locale output is blocked or clearly marked as a reviewable draft; it is never presented as qualified.

Empty collections represent unresolved mappings, never accepted non-applicability. createdAt/updatedAt are projection-build timestamps only; they are not canonical product timestamps. Source facts remain proposals until owners accept the mappings; this artifact does not claim semantic completeness, phase acceptance, or currentness.
